headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_en: CSRC issues warning letter to Hongta Securities
headlines.summary_en: CSRC announced a decision to issue a warning letter to Hongta Securities Co., Ltd.: Upon inspection, it was found that the company had issues such as inadequate on-site quality control inspections, insufficient disclosure in sponsor work reports, and lax acceptance of underlying documents. These violations contravene Articles 55 and 85 of the Guidelines for Internal Control of Investment Banking Business of Securities Companies and Article 31 of the Measures for the Administration of Sponsorship Business for Securities Issuance and Listing. In accordance with Article 64 of the Sponsorship Measures, the CSRC decided to impose the administrative supervision measure of issuing a warning letter to the company. The company should strengthen internal control over its investment banking business and hold relevant responsible personnel internally accountable.

headlines.title_en: CSRC issues warning letter to Century Securities Co., Ltd.
headlines.summary_en: Upon investigation, the CSRC found that Century Securities Co., Ltd. had issues such as lax quality control and internal review, and non-standard compensation management. These violations contravene Article 31 of the Measures for the Administration of Sponsorship Business for Securities Issuance and Listing (the Sponsorship Measures), Article 28 of the Measures for Compliance Management of Securities Companies and Securities Investment Fund Management Companies, and Articles 7 and 61 of the Guidelines for Internal Control of Investment Banking Business of Securities Companies. In accordance with Article 64 of the Sponsorship Measures, the CSRC decided to impose the administrative supervision measure of issuing a warning letter to the company. The company should strengthen internal control over its investment banking business and hold relevant responsible personnel internally accountable. (CSRC)

headlines.title_en: CSRC issues warning letter to GF Securities Co., Ltd.
headlines.summary_en: CSRC: Upon investigation, the CSRC found that GF Securities Co., Ltd. had issues such as insufficient independence of quality control departments and non-standard project charging. These violations contravene Article 6 of the Measures for Compliance Management of Securities Companies and Securities Investment Fund Management Companies (the Compliance Measures) and Articles 5 and 22 of the Guidelines for Internal Control of Investment Banking Business of Securities Companies. In accordance with Article 32 of the Compliance Measures, the CSRC decided to impose the administrative supervision measure of issuing a warning letter to the company. headlines.title: 证监会对国融证券采取责令改正措施
headlines.summary: 证监会发布关于对国融证券股份有限公司采取责令改正措施的决定：经查，我会发现你公司存在承销保荐项目尽职调查不到位；质控、内核把关不严格；报送材料审批管理不到位等问题。上述情况违反了《证券发行上市保荐业务管理办法》（以下简称《保荐办法》）第十七条、三十一条，《证券公司投资银行类业务内部控制指引》第七条、七十七条，《公司债券发行与交易管理办法》（以下称《债券办法》）第四十一条的规定。根据《保荐办法》第六十四条、《债券办法》第六十九条，我会决定对你公司采取责令改正的行政监督管理措施。

headlines.title_en: CSRC orders Guorong Securities to take corrective measures
headlines.summary_en: CSRC issued a decision on taking corrective measures against Guorong Securities Co., Ltd.: Upon inspection, it was found that the company had issues such as inadequate due diligence on underwriting and sponsorship projects, lax quality control and internal review, and inadequate management of material submission approval. These violations contravene Articles 17 and 31 of the Measures for the Administration of Sponsorship Business for Securities Issuance and Listing (the Sponsorship Measures), Articles 7 and 77 of the Guidelines for Internal Control of Investment Banking Business of Securities Companies, and Article 41 of the Measures for the Administration of Issuance and Trading of Corporate Bonds (the Bond Measures). In accordance with Article 64 of the Sponsorship Measures and Article 69 of the Bond Measures, the CSRC decided to impose the administrative supervision measure of corrective action on the company.

headlines.summary: *ST卓然公告，公司因未在法定期限内披露2025年年度报告，股票自2026年5月6日起停牌，后于2026年7月7日复牌并被实施退市风险警示。若被实施退市风险警示之日起2个月内仍未披露过半数董事保证真实、准确、完整的2025年年度报告，公司股票将被终止上市。公司及实际控制人已被中国证监会立案调查，若触及重大违法强制退市情形，股票将被实施重大违法强制退市。目前公司2025年年度报告编制工作正在全力推进中。

headlines.title_en: *ST Zhuoran: Discloses fourth risk warning notice on termination of listing
headlines.summary_en: *ST Zhuoran announced that due to failure to disclose its 2025 annual report within the statutory period, its shares were suspended from trading on May 6, 2026, and resumed trading on July 7, 2026 with a delisting risk warning. If the 2025 annual report confirmed by more than half of directors as true, accurate and complete is not disclosed within 2 months from the delisting risk warning date, the company's shares will be terminated from listing. The company and its actual controller have been placed under investigation by the CSRC; if major illegal mandatory delisting circumstances are triggered, the shares will be subject to major illegal mandatory delisting. The preparation of the 2025 annual report is currently being actively advanced.

headlines.title: 香港证监会：裁定潘迪生在披露11.5亿港元企业意外收益前进行内幕交易罪成

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC: Rules Pandison guilty of insider trading before disclosing HK$1.15 billion corporate windfall
headlines.summary_en: The Hong Kong SFC announced that the Market Misconduct Tribunal ruled that Dickson Concepts (International) Limited (Dickson Concepts) founder and former group executive chairman and businessman Dickson Poon and his investment holding company Equity Advantage Limited (Equity) committed insider dealing in the company's shares while in possession of inside information about a transaction that would eventually bring approximately HK$1.15 billion in cash to Dickson Concepts.

headlines.title: 我国开展为期一年的深化扫黑除恶专项斗争
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记陈文清近日在全国扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议上强调，要扎实开展为期一年的深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，依法清除一切侵蚀社会肌体的毒瘤，努力建设更高水平的平安中国，续写社会长期稳定新篇章。

headlines.title_en: China launches year-long campaign to intensify special crackdown on organized crime and vice
headlines.summary_en: Chen Wenqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, stressed at a recent national video conference on the special campaign against gang crime that a one-year deepening special campaign against gang crime should be solidly carried out, all cancers eroding the social body should be legally removed, efforts should be made to build a higher level of Safe China, and a new chapter of long-term social stability should be written.

headlines.title: 兆易创新：拟以10亿元-20亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 兆易创新公告，拟以不低于人民币10亿元且不超过人民币20亿元回购公司A股股份，回购价格不超过750元/股，回购股份将全部用于注销并减少注册资本，回购资金来源为自有资金及/或自筹资金，回购期限自股东会审议通过之日起6个月内。

headlines.title_en: GigaDevice: Plans to repurchase shares worth RMB 1-2 billion
headlines.summary_en: GigaDevice announced a plan to repurchase its A-shares for no less than RMB 1 billion and no more than RMB 2 billion, at a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 750 per share. All repurchased shares will be cancelled to reduce registered capital, with funds sourced from自有资金 and/or self-raised funds, within 6 months from shareholder meeting approval.

headlines.title: 法本信息：拟以3000万元-6000万元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 法本信息公告，拟以不低于人民币3000万元且不超过人民币6000万元回购公司股份，回购价格不超过22.46元/股。回购股份拟用于维护公司价值及股东权益，将在披露回购结果暨股份变动公告12个月后采用集中竞价交易方式出售，若未能在3年内使用完毕，尚未使用的已回购股份将予以注销。

headlines.title_en: Faben Information: plans to repurchase company shares for 30-60 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Faben Information announced a plan to repurchase its shares for no less than RMB 30 million and no more than RMB 60 million, at a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 22.46 per share. The repurchased shares are intended to maintain company value and protect shareholders' interests, and will be sold through centralized bidding trading after 12 months from the disclosure of the repurchase results and share change announcement; if not fully used within 3 years, the unused repurchased shares will be cancelled.
